## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: evaluate_semantic scores the 40-item human-labelled set from...

The system SHALL ensure that evaluate_semantic scores the 40-item human-labelled set from calibrate-llm-judge-against-human-labels and reaches Cohen's kappa >= 0.7 on the judged dimension; the measured kappa is recorded in the change's artifacts.

#### Scenario: evaluate_semantic scores the 40-item human-labelled set from...

WHEN `replace-the-gen-eval-semantic-judge-with-a-calibrated-noul` is implemented
THEN evaluate_semantic scores the 40-item human-labelled set from calibrate-llm-judge-against-human-labels and reaches Cohen's kappa >= 0.7 on the judged dimension; the measured kappa is recorded in the change's artifacts.

### Requirement: min_confidence gates on noul with no signature change, and existing...

The system SHALL ensure that min_confidence gates on noul with no signature change, and existing semantic_judge tests pass unmodified.

#### Scenario: min_confidence gates on noul with no signature change, and existing...

WHEN `replace-the-gen-eval-semantic-judge-with-a-calibrated-noul` is implemented
THEN min_confidence gates on noul with no signature change, and existing semantic_judge tests pass unmodified.

### Requirement: When the decision helper returns None the module still returns its existing...

The system SHALL ensure that when the decision helper returns None the module still returns its existing skip result, covered by a test.

#### Scenario: When the decision helper returns None the module still returns its existing...

WHEN `replace-the-gen-eval-semantic-judge-with-a-calibrated-noul` is implemented
THEN When the decision helper returns None the module still returns its existing skip result, covered by a test.

### Requirement: Reasoning prose is produced by an LLM only for items that fail the...

The system SHALL ensure that reasoning prose is produced by an LLM only for items that fail the threshold, asserted by a test counting LLM invocations on an all-pass batch (zero).

#### Scenario: Reasoning prose is produced by an LLM only for items that fail the...

WHEN `replace-the-gen-eval-semantic-judge-with-a-calibrated-noul` is implemented
THEN Reasoning prose is produced by an LLM only for items that fail the threshold, asserted by a test counting LLM invocations on an all-pass batch (zero).
